verdict.rationale: Bento's signals are plain-English detectors trained on your own traces that fire in real time on production traffic and backfill history (bentolabs-docs-4, bentolabs-docs-38). Releases are scored 'offline, in CI, and on live traffic' (bentolabs-docs-14), and shadow-mode nudges are scored against live outcomes (bentolabs-docs-12). Signal firings can be inspected and managed from the CLI (bentolabs-docs-34, bentolabs-docs-35, bentolabs-docs-36). Evidence is mostly marketing and summary-level docs. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring online evaluators (sampling, scoring rubrics, custom evaluator definitions), independent or hands-on corroboration of continuous live evaluation.
